svg.aria-label: Website Audit, card back: Crawls a site, reads every screenshot including mobile, and scores it out of 100. Prospect mode hands you evidence for outreach; QA mode gives a ship or don't-ship verdict on a site you built.
svg.text: Crawls a site, reads every screenshot
including mobile, and scores it out of 100.
Prospect mode hands you evidence for
outreach; QA mode gives a ship or
don't-ship verdict on a site you built.
“A false "broken" claim in outreach kills credibility; a
false pass in QA ships a bug.”
